name: RulerLevel
description: Contains first-line indent and hanging indent information for an outline level.
remarks: The RulerLevel object is a member of the RulerLevels collection. The RulerLevels collection contains a RulerLevel object for each of the five available outline levels.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: FirstMargin
properties.description: Returns or sets the first-line indent for the specified outline level, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: LeftMargin
properties.description: Returns or sets the left indent for the specified outline level, in points. Read/write.
